meta.title: My kitchen
meta.description: The appliances and tools I own, so nothing is suggested that I can't cook.

hero.title: My kitchen
hero.note: I only suggest what you can actually cook

scan.title: Scan the kitchen
scan.intro: Take up to {max} photos of the worktop, cupboards and drawers. I'll tell you what I see and you confirm.
scan.found: {count, plural, one {I spotted # new thing} other {I spotted # new things}}
scan.nothingNew: I didn't see anything you don't already have.

checklist.title: What I have
checklist.intro: Tap to mark what you have. Nothing that needs an unmarked item will ever be suggested.

toasts.added: {count, plural, one {Added to your kitchen} other {# things added to your kitchen}}
toasts.scanFailed: I couldn't look at the photos. Try again.
toasts.rateLimited: You've reached today's scan limit. Try tomorrow.
